name: Popconfirm (web component)
summary: The popconfirm as a framework-free element, for code that cannot load the antd Popconfirm: a small prompt anchored to its trigger with a warning glyph, a title, an optional description and Cancel and OK buttons.
highlights: Same look as the antd Popconfirm, no antd needed
ok-text, ok-danger, confirm-loading, test ids on both buttons
Esc and an outside click cancel; focus moves in and back
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-popconfirm>, that reproduces the antd Popconfirm as themed by popconfirmTheme value for value: the prompt is the shared <aha-popover> (white, radius 8, its border, shadow and arrow, twelve placements, flip and top layer), holding the warning glyph in the default ink 8 before a 14/22 SemiBold title, an optional description 4 below it, and Cancel and OK at the DS small size (28 high, 4 corners) on the right. The trigger is its child, as in antd. It exists for apps that are dropping antd (the Manage app) and pages that never load it. Its attributes follow the antd props one for one (title → heading, okText → ok-text, okButtonProps.danger or destructiveConfirm → ok-danger, okButtonProps.disabled → ok-disabled, okButtonProps.loading → confirm-loading, disabled, placement, open), so a migration is a rename. The antd Popconfirm with popconfirm-theme.js stays the choice in React and Vue 3 apps that keep antd.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, so the render is identical in React, Vue and plain HTML. The trigger is the element's child. A trigger click emits a cancelable `open` (detail.source trigger) and opens it unless cancelled; OK emits a cancelable `confirm`; Cancel, Escape, an outside click and a second trigger click emit a cancelable `cancel` (detail.source cancel-button, escape, outside or trigger); unless cancelled either goes on to the cancelable `close`, then the prompt closes and emits `closed`. Controlled open: set `open` from your state and call preventDefault() on `open` and `close`, then flip your state yourself; or let the element open and close itself and mirror it from `open` and `closed`. For an async confirm, preventDefault() the `confirm`, set `confirm-loading`, and remove `open` when the work resolves. React 18 has no custom-element event props: bind `open`, `confirm`, `cancel` and `closed` through a ref with addEventListener, pass booleans as `attr={flag ? '' : undefined}` (React 18 writes `false` as the string "false", which the element also reads as off), and write the kebab-case attribute names. The antd props map: title → heading (or slot="title"), description → description (or slot="description"), icon → a child with slot="icon" (the warning glyph is the default, so `<aha-icon name="system-warning-circle">` can go), icon={null} → no-icon, okText → ok-text, cancelText → cancel-text, {...destructiveConfirm} or okButtonProps={{ danger }} → ok-danger, okButtonProps={{ disabled }} → ok-disabled, {{ loading }} → confirm-loading, okButtonProps / cancelButtonProps={{ 'data-testid' }} → ok-test-id / cancel-test-id, disabled → disabled, placement → placement, open → open, onConfirm / onCancel → the `confirm` / `cancel` events, onOpenChange → `open` and `closed`. ok-text defaults to OK only as a fallback: set a verb that says what happens (Delete, Remove member).

spec.label: Prompt
spec.value: the shared aha-popover panel: white (bg-elevated), 1px border-default, radius 8, its shadow and arrow, 12 padding, 180 to 280 wide; pops from the trigger, top by default

spec.label: Message
spec.value: system-warning-circle 16 in the default ink (never a status hue), centred on the title's first line, 8 before the text; title 14/22 SemiBold ink; description 14/22 ink, 4 below the title

spec.label: Buttons
spec.value: 8 below the message, right aligned, 8 apart: Cancel (secondary) then OK (primary), both aha-button sm (28 high, 4 corners, 14 label)

spec.label: Destructive confirm
spec.value: `ok-danger`: Cancel is the primary (Vivid Pink, white label), OK a secondary (white, border-default, ink label), as popconfirm-theme destructiveConfirm

spec.label: Busy
spec.value: `confirm-loading`: OK shows its spinner and ignores clicks; Cancel is disabled, Escape and an outside click do nothing

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: the twelve aha-popover placements (top default); while open it flips to the roomier side and stays 8 inside the viewport, shown in the top layer so no overflow or z-index ancestor clips it

spec.label: Behaviour
spec.value: role dialog named by the title (or `label`); the trigger carries aria-haspopup dialog and aria-expanded; on open focus moves to the primary button (OK, or Cancel when ok-danger or ok-disabled), on close back to the trigger except after an outside click; Escape is taken before an enclosing aha-modal sees it

props.name: open
props.desc: Shows the prompt. Removing it hides it and emits `closed`

props.name: heading
props.desc: The title (antd `title`). Fill `slot="title"` instead for rich content

props.name: description
props.desc: Text under the title. Fill `slot="description"` instead for rich content

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name; overrides the title as the name

props.name: ok-text
props.desc: OK button label. Name the action ("Delete"), not OK

props.name: cancel-text
props.desc: Cancel button label

props.name: ok-danger
props.desc: A destructive confirm: Cancel primary, OK secondary

props.name: ok-disabled
props.desc: Disables OK (antd okButtonProps.disabled)

props.name: confirm-loading
props.desc: OK shows its spinner; Cancel, Escape and an outside click do nothing while set

props.name: disabled
props.desc: A trigger click does not open it

props.name: placement
props.type: top | bottom | left | right | top-start | top-end | bottom-start | bottom-end | left-start | left-end | right-start | right-end
props.desc: Side of the trigger it opens on; flips when that side lacks room

props.name: arrow
props.desc: `arrow="false"` drops the arrow

props.name: no-icon
props.desc: Drops the warning glyph (antd icon={null})

props.name: ok-test-id
props.desc: data-testid on the OK button

props.name: cancel-test-id
props.desc: data-testid on the Cancel button

props.name: inline
props.desc: Stays in the page flow with no keys, no outside click and no focus move. For docs and previews

props.name: default slot
props.desc: The trigger, usually an aha-button

props.name: slot="title"
props.desc: Rich title content instead of `heading`

props.name: slot="description"
props.desc: Rich description instead of `description`

props.name: slot="icon"
props.desc: Replaces the warning glyph

props.name: close()
props.desc: Asks to close: emits `close` (source method), closes unless cancelled

props.name: open
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. The trigger was clicked; unless cancelled the prompt opens

props.name: confirm
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. OK was pressed; unless cancelled the prompt closes

props.name: cancel
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. detail.source is cancel-button, escape, outside or trigger; unless cancelled the prompt closes

props.name: close
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. Fires before any close; detail.source is confirm, cancel-button, escape, outside, trigger or method

props.name: closed
props.desc: Composed. The prompt is closed; detail.source as on `close`, or attribute when `open` was removed directly

whenToUse.when: a quick yes or no on one low-risk action, next to its button, on a page that does not load antd or is dropping it
a React or Vue 3 app that keeps antd and themes it with popconfirm-theme.js
a confirmation that needs more than two lines, a form field, or blocks the whole page

opinion.note: Phrase the title as a question and name OK the action. A destructive confirm sets `ok-danger`, so Cancel is the primary and Enter on the focused button keeps the item. Keep the description to one or two short lines; anything longer is a Modal.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the inline, open destructive example.
conformance.measure: (function(){var r=document.querySelector('aha-popconfirm[data-probe]').shadowRoot;function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var pop=r.querySelector('.pop').shadowRoot.querySelector('.pop');var p=cs(pop);var t=cs(r.querySelector('.title'));var d=cs(r.querySelector('.description'));var ok=cs(r.querySelector('.ok').shadowRoot.querySelector('button'));var cancel=cs(r.querySelector('.cancel').shadowRoot.querySelector('button'));var icon=r.querySelector('slot[name=icon] aha-icon');return{surface:p.backgroundColor,radius:p.borderTopLeftRadius,pad:p.paddingTop,role:pop.getAttribute('role'),titleColor:t.color,titleSize:t.fontSize,titleWeight:t.fontWeight,titleLine:t.lineHeight,descColor:d.color,buttonHeight:ok.height,buttonRadius:ok.borderTopLeftRadius,cancelBg:cancel.backgroundColor,okBg:ok.backgroundColor,icon:icon?icon.getAttribute('name'):null};})()
